newsitem.title: USA: Phil Fed's Trebing--data point to moderate growth.
newsitem.headline: Phil Fed's Trebing--data point to moderate growth.

text.p: Michael Trebing, an economist at the Philadelphia Federal Reserve Bank, said forward-looking data on his region's manufacturing sector are consistent with accounts that call for slow, moderate growth ahead.

Speaking on a teleconference with reporters after the Fed bank released its monthly business outlook survey, Trebing said, "The future index numbers and the responses we get regarding forecasts for the next six months are consistent with the stories of slow, moderate growth ... I think that's consistent with the story of somewhat slower, slower than moderate, growth in the next six months."
The Fed bank said its index of area manufacturing activity fell to 13.9 in September from 21.5 in August.
Meanwhile, its index of prices paid by manufacturers jumped to 18.0 from 4.6 percent the precious month.
